decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Site Location Plan entitled Dwg: 01;</li><li>Proposed Site Plan entitled Dwg: 11 Rev A;</li><li>Proposed Ground Floor Plan entitled Dwg: 12 Rev A;</li><li>Proposed First Floor Plan entitled Dwg: 13;</li><li>Proposed Loft Plan entitled Dwg: 14;</li><li>Proposed Roof Plan entitled Dwg: 15;</li><li>Proposed Front/Rear Elevations Plan entitled Dwg: 16 Rev A;</li><li>Proposed Side Elevations Plan entitled Dwg: 17 Rev A;</li><li>Reasonable Exception Statement;</li></ul>
description: Single storey front extension incorporating porch, Single and two storey side to rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front, side and rear roof slopes, Raised patio to rear with privacy screen, External alterations (Demolition of attached garage, side to rear extension and ground floor rear bay window) (amended)
